_meta.title: Deaths during police encounters in the US, 2000–2021 (Fatal Encounters)
_meta.what: People who died during interactions with US police, 2000 to the end of 2021 (all causes: shootings, vehicle pursuits, Tasers, restraint and more), with race, date, place, agency and how they died.
_meta.licence: No formal licence; site says "we let anyone use the data for any reason for free" (https://fatalencounters.org/)
_meta.notes: Data collection appears to have stopped at end of 2021. "race" is as recorded; "race_with_imputations" adds the project's statistical estimates where race was unknown (imputation_probability gives the confidence). image_url: the source asks for no hotlinking — do not load these images on the map. dispositions_exclusions is labelled by the source "INTERNAL USE, NOT FOR ANALYSIS". precision: "address" when an injury address is given, else "city". This core file omits long text; descriptions/supporting links are in police_deaths_fatal_encounters_text.json keyed by id.
_meta.spread_note: Records sharing one town point are spread evenly inside its OpenStreetMap outline (Nominatim reverse lookup); the original point is kept in source_lat/source_lon.
